segments.content:
Chapter 99: 0096 Old Classmates Reunite (Bonus chapter for Alliance Leader Tie Xue Qi Dui Zhang)

Many people showed up for the National Day gathering.

Somehow, that guy Li Rui had even managed to invite the senior students who graduated from County No. 2 High School last year.

For instance, last year's top science student from Sichuan Province, Senior Chen, who was now studying biology at Qinghua.

Chen Guiliang and Wu Meng went to Wudaokou to meet up with Senior Chen.

When they got there, they found not only Senior Chen, but also Lu Wei from the China University of Geosciences and Li Yunxiang from the University of Science and Technology Beijing. Both of them were science students from County No. 2 High School, in the same year as Chen Guiliang.

In particular, Lu Wei had been in the same class as Chen Guiliang during their first year of high school, before the arts and sciences streams were separated.

"Damn, Chen Guiliang, you're awesome! I never thought you'd get into Beida!" Lu Wei exclaimed as soon as he saw him.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "It's alright."

Wu Meng asked, "Is it just us?"

Li Yunxiang said, "Kong Juan from Class 15 is at Beijing Normal University. She's waiting for us directly at Tiananmen."

Wu Meng said admiringly, "Kong Juan is really amazing. She didn't even get into the experimental arts class when they split the streams, but she started working hard in the second semester of her second year and managed to get into the top ten of the year in every exam. She got a super high score on the Gaokao too."

Senior Chen checked his watch. After shaking hands and exchanging pleasantries, he didn't say much.

He hadn't actually wanted to join in on the fun. It was a gathering for his juniors from his alma mater, and there was no need for him to get involved. But Li Rui was a distant relative and had called him several times, insisting on dragging him along.

Lu Wei asked, "Senior Chen, is the biology program at Qinghua especially difficult?"

"Biology is okay," Senior Chen said. "The physics class I signed up for is an English-taught class. My English isn't great, the professor lectures entirely in English, and I could only guess my way through the exam questions. I almost failed physics."

Everyone, including Chen Guiliang, was surprised.

What on earth was a physics class taught and examined entirely in English?

Chen Guiliang started thinking about promoting Legends of the Three Kingdoms at Qinghua and asked casually, "Senior Chen, have you joined any clubs?"

"I joined two," said Senior Chen.

Chen Guiliang took out his phone and seized the opportunity to ask for his number.

Of course, he got everyone else's number too. For those without phones, he asked for their QQ and email addresses.

Before long, their old third-year class president, Li Rui, came over to meet them with a female sophomore senior.

The senior students acted as tour guides, leading everyone on the subway, transferring from Line 13 to Line 2.

With today's traffic, taking the subway was the only way to get there!

"Are you guys here yet?"

"Almost."

"We're already at the square watching the flag."

Bian Guanyue's voice sounded a little excited. It was her first time seeing the flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square in person.

When Chen Guiliang and the others got there by train, they found it was a sea of people.

National Day…

"Whose brilliant idea was this?" Lu Wei asked.

The former class president, Li Rui, said weakly, "Mine... My mistake. Should we go somewhere else?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Since we're already here, let's go take a group photo."

It took them ages just to find everyone; calling them on their phones was completely useless.

Touring the Forbidden City was out of the question. You could die waiting in that line.

After a great deal of effort, everyone finally gathered, took a few group photos, and then headed for Qinghua and Beida. The students from other universities wanted to visit the two top schools.

And so, they took the subway back.

The subway was also packed with tourists. There were no seats even in broad daylight. Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue held onto the same pole, whispering to each other.

"Have you been doing okay?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's even more packed than the last semester of high school."

Bian Guanyue said, "I asked Wu Meng. She said you guys in the Yuanpei Program are all crazy about signing up for classes. You're either in class or on your way to class all day long."

"It's not that exaggerated," Chen Guiliang laughed.

Perhaps because there were too many passengers, Bian Guanyue leaned closer to Chen Guiliang, almost into his arms.

Chen Guiliang freed a hand and protectively shielded Bian Guanyue, the two of them ending up in a half-embrace.

Bian Guanyue's muscles tensed up, but then quickly relaxed, her shoulder resting lightly against Chen Guiliang.

Chen Guiliang took a faint sniff. "Your hair smells so good."

Bian Guanyue blushed. "It's just regular shampoo."

"Looks like you're naturally fragrant then," Chen Guiliang said.

Bian Guanyue stopped talking, but leaned even closer to Chen Guiliang, as if being pushed by other passengers.

Li Rui was standing not far away. Watching Chen Guiliang's actions, he really wanted to hold Wu Meng too. But he felt a little insecure, because he hadn't gotten into Qinghua or Beida...

In high school, these two were the class president and the academic representative, respectively. The class president had once tentatively pursued the academic representative, but she had said, "Let's talk about dating after we both get into Qinghua or Beida."

The academic representative got into Beida.

The class president had underperformed and only got into Renmin University.

A rather ridiculous tragic story.

They transferred subway lines and got off at Wudaokou. Senior Chen led them on a tour of Qinghua.

Everyone rented bicycles.

Chen Guiliang rented an old-fashioned Rod-brake bicycle. This beat-up bike was quite old; who knows how many Qinghua students it had seen off.

Bian Guanyue sat sideways behind him, her head resting on Chen Guiliang's back, enjoying the scenery of the Qinghua campus.

A bicycle, a university, a boy giving a girl a ride.

Chen Guiliang felt incredibly satisfied. He had fantasized about such a scene during his university days in his previous life, but he was too poor back then to even dare think about dating.

They all rode to the Second School Gate, the one with the words "Qing Hua Yuan" on its lintel.

Check-in, take photos.

Although digital cameras existed, film cameras were more popular, and it was easier to pay the deposit when renting one. You could rent one for a deposit of just a few dozen yuan.

Chen Guiliang's mind drifted back to his business again.

He hoped digital cameras would get cheaper and more widespread, which would make it easier for students to upload photos on the campus network.

"That's the Qinghua Xuetang, Qinghua's earliest academic building. Qian Zhongshu, Ji Xianlin, and others studied in there..." Senior Chen played the part of a tour guide.

Bian Guanyue's attention was on Chen Guiliang. She barely glanced at the campus scenery and didn't hear a word Senior Chen was saying.

After a short tour, it was nearly noon, and Senior Chen took them to experience a Qinghua cafeteria.

Bian Guanyue had zero dating experience. She carefully recalled how her paternal and maternal grandparents interacted. After struggling for a while, she copied how her maternal grandmother would serve her maternal grandfather, placing a piece of braised pork in Chen Guiliang's bowl and saying, "You seem to like meat, eat more. I'll get fat if I eat too much."

Chen Guiliang winked at her with a smile.

Bian Guanyue wasn't shy this time and responded with a smiling wink of her own.

It was as if they could transmit Morse code to each other with their blinks.

Kong Juan from Beijing Normal University nudged Wu Meng with her elbow. "Are those two really dating?"

"They got together a while ago," Wu Meng said with a grin. She had been shipping this couple since their third year of high school.

Kong Juan said, "A perfect match. I'm so envious."

Wu Meng said, "You should find someone quickly too."

"I'll take my time. I just started university, no rush," Kong Juan said.

Li Rui listened from the side, glancing at Wu Meng from time to time, but Wu Meng hardly looked at him.

The class president sighed inwardly, knowing he had no chance.

Perhaps Wu Meng had just been brushing him off back in high school.

Senior Chen quickly finished his lunch and said to everyone, "You guys can look around on your own this afternoon. I have something to do."

"Take care, Senior!"

"Goodbye."

After wandering around Qinghua for a while, the group headed for Beida. This time, it was Chen Guiliang and Wu Meng's turn to be the guides.

They toured until evening, when Chen Guiliang treated them to dinner outside the South Gate.

After a satisfying meal, they all went their separate ways, leaving only the lone man and woman.

"It's past eight. Should we go find you a place to stay?" Chen Guiliang said.

"Let's walk around a bit more," Bian Guanyue said, her cheeks flushed.

Chen Guiliang smiled. "I'll take you to a great place."

He went back to get his ride—a second-hand bicycle—and gave Bian Guanyue a ride straight to the PKU Science Park.

Pointing to a cramped office, Chen Guiliang said proudly, "That's my turf!"

"You've started a company?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang grinned. "The license hasn't been approved yet, but we've already started working."

The light inside was on. Besides Guo Feng, there was another guy.

Guo Feng made the introduction, "Chen Guiliang, you're just in time. This is the developer and operations guy I recruited for you. He just started working today since it's a holiday. He's a fourth-year from the computer science department of the School of EECS, a real tech genius. He only agreed to help out during the National Day holiday. Whether you can get him to stay will depend on your skills."
